outcome: Expression levels of antioxidative enzymes (superoxide dismutase 1, catalase, periaxin, thioredoxin)
Concentration of antioxidative enzymes in serum
cohort: C57/BL mice in which a preeclampsia (PE) model was established.
finding: Low-dose aspirin treatment partially reversed the PE-induced decrease in antioxidative enzymes, with effects potentially mediated via the AKT/mTOR signaling pathway.
